description: DRAFT hand-authored placement table (review finding 4, S-3, decisions 68, 87, 92). Answers, for an item clicked against face F of a support block: which block state appears at support.offset(F), or that vanilla refuses. Rules are tried in order; the first whose items match decides. Item and block specs are ids or #tags resolved against the data generator's tags for the pinned version. Validated against the server by spike/experiments/e6-data.mjs.

in: logs, wood, stems and other rotated pillars (axis from the clicked face)
saplings (on #minecraft:dirt or farmland, top face only)
torch, soul_torch, redstone_torch (top face: standing torch; side face: wall torch facing away from the support; bottom face: refused)
crop seeds: wheat, beetroot, carrot, potato, melon, pumpkin (on farmland, top face only, age 0)
slabs (type from the clicked face and cursor height)
stairs (facing from the player's horizontal facing, half from face and cursor height; shape straight, neighbours not modelled)
full cubes used as scaffold or building blocks: dirt, cobblestone, stone, planks, cobbled deepslate, netherrack, sand, gravel, glass, crafting table, and any other block the target's defaults cover
out: doors, beds, signs, banners, buttons, levers, rails, redstone wire, fences and walls (connection state), chests and furnaces (facing: covered by the 'player_facing_opposite' rule only for chest, furnace, smoker, blast furnace)
waterlogging (the target is assumed dry), snow layers, candles and sea pickles stacking, double slabs
support that is not a full collision face (fences, walls, slabs as torch support)

support_kinds.any: any non-replaceable block the client may click
support_kinds.sturdy_face: the support's collision shape covers the clicked face completely (approximated by a full-cube collision shape in v0.1)
support_kinds.on: the block under the target matches the listed ids or tags
